summary: Public projects created on 28 October 2026: 2 repos and 3 datasets.
intro: New repositories covered agent tooling and image-model evaluation, with a plugin for documenting and analysing home noise pollution and a periodic check of whether image models can produce stylised tech diagrams with correct text and arrows. On Hugging Face, the new work was evaluation material for that graphics benchmark: its test prompts, every generated image, and the raw human ratings.

projects.name: Noise Pollution Analysis
projects.description: Agent skills to document home noise pollution and analyse recordings at the frequency level: hums, tones, low-frequency drone, cycling.

projects.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark
projects.description: Lightweight periodic check: can image models make colourful, stylised tech diagrams with exact text and correct arrows? Text-to-image and image-to-image.

projects.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark
projects.description: Test prompts for Tech-Graphics-Benchmark: can an image model make a characterful banner or a restyled diagram for a tech repo or blog post without getting the text or the arrows wrong?

projects.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark Ratings
projects.description: Raw human evaluation data for Tech-Graphics-Benchmark: one JSON file per annotated generation, written by the annotation Space.

projects.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark Runs
projects.description: Every image generated for Tech-Graphics-Benchmark, one folder per round.
